name: vmi-name
description: Target VirtualMachineInstance. Required for block PVCs; optional for filesystem PVCs when PVC_NAME or POD_NAME is provided.

name: pvc-name
description: PVC attached to the VMI, or the PVC mounted in the target pod for filesystem mode.

name: pod-name
description: Pod that mounts the filesystem PVC. Used when VMI_NAME and PVC_NAME are not provided.

name: namespace
description: Namespace containing the VMI, PVC, or pod.

name: device-path
description: Device path inside the VMI guest for block mode, for example /dev/vdb. Not the virt-launcher pod path.

name: mount-path
description: Mount path inside the VMI guest when filling a block PVC.

name: filesystem
description: Filesystem to create or mount on the guest block device.

name: fill-percentage
description: Target PVC filesystem usage from 1 to 99 percent; must be above current usage. Defaults to 50 when unset or blank.

name: duration
description: How long to hold the PVC at the target fill percentage, in seconds.

name: format-device
description: Create a filesystem on the guest block device before filling it. This erases existing data on that device.

name: username
description: SSH username used by virtctl for guest block mode.

name: identity-file
description: Private key path inside the container that matches a public key authorized in the guest. Needed for guest block mode.
